explicit_requirements: Calculate weekly gross pay in cents for nonnegative whole hours.
Pay the first 40 hours at the hourly rate and each additional hour at one and a half times that rate.
Accept only positive even integer-cent hourly rates and reject other inputs.

scenarios.name: Calculate regular and overtime gross pay
scenarios.behavior: Calculate the first 40 hours at the hourly rate and only additional hours at one and a half times that rate, returning gross pay in cents.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly specifies the two pay bands and monetary unit.

scenarios.name: Handle zero hours
scenarios.behavior: For zero hours at an allowed rate, return zero gross pay.
scenarios.reason: Zero belongs to the explicitly permitted nonnegative hours and yields zero under the stated pay formula.

scenarios.name: Reject inputs outside the pay contract
scenarios.behavior: Reject negative or non-integer hours and hourly rates that are not positive even integer numbers of cents.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly constrains both inputs and requires rejection of other inputs.

scenarios.name: Preserve gross pay without tax deduction
scenarios.behavior: Return the calculated gross amount without deducting tax.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly forbids tax deduction.
